concerns.analysis: The output contains an unauthorized correction/alteration to an acronym. The source PDF reads 'CRMS', whereas the extraction altered this to 'CMRS' (presumably auto-corrected by the LLM). While CMRS is common telecom terminology, it is an exact wording alteration of the source document.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Draft rules presented would require CRMS providers to absorb the cost of 988.
concerns.output_quote: Draft rules presented would require CMRS providers to absorb the cost of 988.

concerns.analysis: A single continuous numbered list (1 through 11) spans the entire document. In the source, this list is interrupted by tables (e.g., between item 4 and 5). However, the output splits this single continuous list into multiple independent ordered lists that will restart at 1 (as they lack any continuation indexing), and explicitly includes the numbering ('4.', '5.', '6.') as plain text inside the <li> text elements. This breaks list continuity and semantic numbering.
